newsitem.title: UK: UK's ECGD resumes export cover for Venezuela.
newsitem.headline: UK's ECGD resumes export cover for Venezuela.

text.p: Britain's Export Credits Guarantee Department is resuming support for the export of capital goods to Venezuela, Trade Minister Lord Clinton-Davis said on Monday.
"This will be welcome news for a number of British exporters who now appear to be in a good position to win valuable orders in this improving market," he said.

Cover has been suspended for the past year, except for exports to the state oil company PDVSA. The suspension followed a period of economic difficulty in Venezuela when the government restricted access to foreign exchange. -- London Newsroom +44 171 5427767
